pll1d19c3-d1e3477.summary: Announces that it remains to show that no person exceeds another in magnitude or power, starting with magnitude.

pll1d19c3-d1e3480.summary: States that the Father is not greater than the Son, nor Father or Son than the Spirit; two together are not greater than one, nor three than two; nor is the essence greater in three than in two or one, since it is whole in each.
claims: No person is greater than another.
Several persons together are not greater than one.
The essence is whole in each person.

pll1d19c3-d1e3483.summary: Cites John Damascene: the whole nature of the Godhead is perfectly in each hypostasis, in Father, Son, and Spirit, so each is perfect God.
claims: The whole divine nature is in each person.

pl-l1d19c3.summary: Begins to show that no person exceeds another in magnitude (power will follow). The Father is not greater than the Son, nor Father or Son than the Spirit; two persons together are not greater than one, nor three than two; the essence is not greater in three than in one, since it is whole in each. John Damascene: the whole nature of the Godhead is perfectly in each hypostasis, so each is perfect God.
claims: No person is greater than another.
Two persons together are not greater than one, nor three than two.
The essence is not greater in three than in one, since it is whole in each person.
The whole divine nature is perfectly in each person, so each is perfect God.
